# BLab Design System React package

This directory contains the packaged public React contract consumed by the Web 1.1.0 consumer surface.

- Package: `@byungsker/blab-design-system@0.2.0`
- Source: `https://github.com/byungsker/blab_design_system`
- Source commit: `10a9016f58b30728f179f1c96b0ed738c40c271c`
- Artifact: `byungsker-blab-design-system-0.2.0.tgz`
- SHA-256: `4a3508b4e01de95c0e90269b9cc891bafcba51a05240ecef871b6295f378bd7a`

The artifact was produced with `npm pack` from `packages/react` after the package build completed. It is used through the package's public `.` and `./styles.css` exports; Bookgolas does not import BLDS source files or private implementation modules.
